app.title: Show HN: I have trained 15 blood glucose forecasting models on my own data
app.description: Repository containing 15 machine learning models trained for blood glucose forecasting on personal data, with training, evaluation, and inference scripts.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and install dependencies via pip
Run the training script on the provided sample dataset and verify that training completes without errors
Load the pretrained model and perform inference on a held‑out test set, checking that prediction shape matches expectations
Measure training time and compare it against a baseline model (e.g., simple linear regression)
Export the model as a PMML/ONNX file and load it with an alternative runtime to ensure interoperability
